summary.result: Selected H 2 S and NH 3 sensors showed the average error of 5.3% comparing to standard gas concentrations.
summary.background: As pig farm workers have been aging and feminized, the damage to the health of the harsh environment is getting serious, and real-time monitoring is needed to prevent the damage.
summary.method: The purpose of this study is to develop an wearable based device to monitor the hazardous environment exposed to workers working in pig farms.
